faq_heading: Homes near Bridgeview Elementary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Bridgeview Elementary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school, and the sold prices are measured by distance. Surrey School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Bridgeview Elementary home search find homes?
faq.a: It lists active homes whose listing text names Bridgeview Elementary, so a nearby home that leaves the name out will not show.

faq.q: How much do homes near Bridgeview Elementary sell for?
faq.a: Within 1 km of the school, 11 homes sold between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026. Medians were houses $920,000. A median is the middle price and is shown where at least 5 homes sold.

faq.q: How fast do homes sell near Bridgeview Elementary?
faq.a: Within 1 km of Bridgeview Elementary the median was 28 days on the market, closing at 95.5% of the list price, with 0% of sales above the list price for the 11 homes within 1 km.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Bridgeview Elementary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are Theresa Clarke Elementary (1.4 km south), James Ardiel Elementary (1.9 km east) and K B Woodward Elementary (1.9 km south).

Bridgeview Elementary is an elementary school in Surrey (Surrey School District), at 12834 115a Ave. It teaches grades K to 7.
Use the search below to see homes for sale that name Bridgeview Elementary in the listing, then check the sold prices within 1 km of the school.
How the Bridgeview Elementary search works

MLS® listings are not tagged by school. This search finds houses, townhomes and condos whose description names Bridgeview Elementary, so a home close to the school whose listing leaves the name out will not appear, and a listing that names the school can sit farther than 1 km away. Use the sold prices below for the distance-based picture, and ask Jared to watch for homes near the school that the search misses.
What homes within 1 km of Bridgeview Elementary sold for
Between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026, 11 homes sold within 1 km of Bridgeview Elementary: 9 houses and 2 townhomes. The largest group was houses, at a median of $920,000.

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of Bridgeview Elementary

16 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of Bridgeview Elementary in a straight line (11 elementary, 3 secondary, 2 other; 6 independent). The closest is Theresa Clarke Elementary, 1.4 km away, and the farthest on this list is Our Lady of Good Counsel, 3.0 km away. By type, the nearest secondary school is Khalsa Secondary School (Surrey) (2.2 km); the nearest independent school is Khalsa School Old Yale Road (2.0 km); the nearest school listing a French Immersion program is K B Woodward Elementary (1.9 km). Other elementary schools close by: Theresa Clarke Elementary (1.4 km south), James Ardiel Elementary (1.9 km east), K B Woodward Elementary (1.9 km south), Khalsa School Old Yale Road (2.0 km south-west), Surrey Traditional (2.1 km east). The nearest school teaching the same grades (K-7) is Theresa Clarke Elementary, 1.4 km south of Bridgeview Elementary.
